Name: Writable Books and Notes
Author: Trapyy
Description:
[size=5][b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Trapyy/mods]My Other Mods[/url][/b][/size]
If you like the mod and want to support my work, you can do so on my [color=#ff7700][url=https://ko-fi.com/trapyy]Ko-Fi[/url][/color]!


[size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Your farmer has a story. Now you can write it down.

[b]Books and Notes[/b] adds writable books and two-sided notes to Stardew Valley. Keep a farm journal, plan your next season, write your own stories, or leave messages for your co-op friends.

These are actual items you can carry, store in chests, share with other players, and display on tables. Open one, click on the paper, and start writing!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54597/54597-1792961121-1975935525.gif[/img]

[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54597/54597-1792960517-1440840356.png[/img][/b][/size]
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Writable Books:[/b] Fill up to 50 pages with your own stories, plans, guides, and memories.[/*]
[*][b]Two-Sided Notes:[/b] Write on the front and back of a single note. Perfect for reminders, shopping lists, and letters.[/*]
[*][b]Write Directly on the Paper:[/b] Click between letters to position your cursor, drag to select text, and use familiar shortcuts for copying, pasting, cutting, and undoing changes.[/*]
[*][b]Animated Writing:[/b] Your text follows the curve of the paper as you turn pages, instead of disappearing during the animation.[/*]
[*][b]Colored Bookmarks:[/b] Add up to 10 bookmarks per book, choose from eight colors, and give them optional names.[/*]
[*][b]Titles and Signatures:[/b] Give your finished work a custom title and sign it with your farmer's name.[/*]
[*][b]Read from Furniture:[/b] Place books and notes on compatible tables and read them without picking them up.[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal Books:[/b] Collect four seasonal book variants from festival shops and unlock their crafting recipes.[/*]
[*][b]Controller Support:[/b] Navigate pages, position the writing cursor, and type using the game's on-screen keyboard.[/*]
[*][b]Share Your Writing:[/b] Leave a note in a friend's chest or pass a book around your multiplayer farm. The writing stays with the item.[/*]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Requirements and Installation[/b][/size]

Install the following mods and their requirements:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] — version 4.5.2 or newer.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — version 2.7.0 or newer.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment[/url] — version 1.15.1 or newer.[/*]
[*][https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43861]StardewUI Continued[/url] — version 0.6.4 or newer.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url] — version 1.3.0 or newer provides the materials used to make your books and notes.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional, for changing settings in-game.[/*]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]Download Books and Notes.[/*]
[*]Extract both [b]BooksAndNotes[/b] and [b][CP] BooksAndNotes[/b] into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. Keep both folders installed.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Crafting Your First Book or Note[/b][/size]

The default book and note recipes are unlocked automatically. You can choose to craft it or buy it directly from Pierre's Store.

[list]
[*][b]Writable Book:[/b] 50 Paper + 2 Leather + 1 Glue + 1 String.[/*]
[*][b]Writable Note:[/b] 1 Paper.[/*]
[/list]
Gather the materials below, then make your book or note from the game's Crafting Menu.

[b]You only need one of the listed methods for each material, not every method![/b]


[size=4][b]Paper[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Put 10 Wood into a Bone Mill to make 10 Paper in 1 day.[/*]
[*]Put any 1 Dwarf Scroll into a Recycling Machine to make 1 Paper in 2 hours.[/*]
[*]Put 1 Soggy Newspaper into a Dehydrator for half a day. This can produce multiple Paper.[/*]
[/list]


[size=4][b]Leather[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Put 10 Bug Meat into a Dehydrator to make 1 Leather in 2 days.[/*]
[*]Put 1 Ancient Drum into a Recycling Machine to make 1 Leather in 2 days.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Glue[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Put 100 Sap and 1 Coal into a Furnace to make 1 Glue in 2 days.[/*]
[*]Put 20 Bone Fragments and 1 Coal into a Furnace to make 1 Glue in 2 days.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]String[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Put 50 Fiber into a Loom to make 1 String in 2 days.[/*]
[*]Put 10 Moss into a Loom to make 1 String in 2 days.[/*]
[*]Craft 1 String from 5 Thread in the Crafting Menu.[/*]
[/list]
If you choose the Thread route:

[list]
[*]Put 1 Duck Feather into a Recycling Machine to make 1 Thread in 1 day.[/*]
[*]Put 1 Ornate Fan into a Recycling Machine to make 1 Thread in 2 days.[/*]
[/list]
All processing times are in-game time.


[size=5][b]Seasonal Books[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54597/54597-1792959845-2131743389.png[/img]
Want a different design for your journal? Look for seasonal books at festival shops!

[b]Buying a seasonal book also permanently teaches that farmer its crafting recipe.[/b] Afterward, you can craft that variant in any season.

[list]
[*][b]Spring Book:[/b] Sold at the Egg Festival and Flower Dance for 2,000g. Craft with the standard book materials + 1 Tulip.[/*]
[*][b]Summer Book:[/b] Sold at the Luau and Dance of the Moonlight Jellies for 2,000g. Craft with the standard book materials + 1 Sunflower.[/*]
[*][b]Fall Book:[/b] Sold at the Stardew Valley Fair for 1,000 Star Tokens, or at Spirit's Eve for 2,000g. Craft with the standard book materials + 1 Yam.[/*]
[*][b]Winter Book:[/b] Sold at the Festival of Ice and Feast of the Winter Star for 2,000g. Craft with the standard book materials + 1 Snow Yam.[/*]
[/list]
Every variant has the same 50-page capacity and writing features. Receiving a seasonal book from another player or a chest does not unlock its recipe, you need to purchase one yourself.


[size=5][b]Reading and Writing[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Hold a book or note and right-click to open it. You can also right-click it directly in your inventory.[/*]
[*]Click on the paper and start typing.[/*]
[*]Click between letters to move the writing cursor, or hold and drag to select text.[/*]
[*]Use the page corners to turn book pages. Notes have [b]Front[/b] and [b]Back[/b] buttons.[/*]
[*]Press Escape when you're finished. Your draft is kept, you do not need to sign it.[/*]
[/list]
Each page keeps its own writing. Text wraps within that page rather than spilling onto the next one. If a large paste does not fit, only the portion that fits is inserted.

[b]Useful keyboard controls:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Ctrl+A:[/b] Select all text on the current page.[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V:[/b] Copy, cut, and paste.[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y:[/b] Undo and redo.[/*]
[*][b]Shift + arrow keys:[/b] Extend your selection.[/*]
[*][b]Arrow keys / Home / End:[/b] Move the writing cursor.[/*]
[*][b]Tab:[/b] Switch between the two visible book pages.[/*]
[/list]
Writing is plain text. You do not need to learn any special formatting commands.


[size=5][b]Bookmarks[/b][/size]

Open the spread you want to remember and click [b]Bookmarks[/b] above the book.

Choose a color, optionally enter a name, then click [b]Add bookmark[/b]. The bookmark points to the first page of that spread.

[list]
[*]Each book can hold [b]10 bookmarks[/b].[/*]
[*]Choose from [b]eight ribbon colors[/b].[/*]
[*]Click a ribbon to return to its spread with the page turn animation.[/*]
[*]Hover over a ribbon to see its name and page number.[/*]
[*]Open Bookmarks on an already bookmarked spread to rename, recolor, or remove that bookmark.[/*]
[/list]
Closing the bookmark window without saving discards your changes.

[b]You can still edit bookmarks after signing a book.[/b] Notes do not have bookmarks.


[size=5][b]Titles and Signing[/b][/size]

When your book or note is finished, select [b]Title & sign[/b], enter a title of up to [b]50 characters[/b], and choose [b]Sign & close[/b].

Your title becomes the item's inventory name, and its description shows your farmer's name as the author.

[color=#ff7700][b]Signing permanently locks the writing. You cannot edit the text afterward.[/b][/color]

You can keep an editable draft for as long as you like. Opening the signing window does not commit anything. Cancel or Escape returns to your draft.


[size=5][b]Displaying Books and Notes[/b][/size]

Hold a book or note and right-click an empty, compatible table within reach to place it.

[list]
[*][b]Right-click a displayed book or note[/b] to read it without removing it.[/*]
[*]You can turn pages, use bookmark ribbons, and read both sides of notes while they are displayed.[/*]
[*]Displayed documents are read-only, even if they are unsigned drafts. Pick them up before editing, signing, or changing bookmarks.[/*]
[*]Use normal furniture pickup controls to retrieve them.[/*]
[/list]
Books and notes need a suitable furniture surface; they cannot be placed directly on the floor.


[size=5][b]Playing with a Controller[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Use the normal action button to open a held book or note.[/*]
[*]In the inventory, press [b]X[/b] over the item while your cursor slot is empty.[/*]
[*]Press [b]A[/b] on the paper to position the writing cursor, then press [b]A[/b] again to open the on-screen keyboard.[/*]
[*]Use the [b]D-pad or left stick[/b] to move the writing cursor.[/*]
[*]While editing a page, [b]X[/b] inserts a new line and [b]Y[/b] erases.[/*]
[*]Use [b]LB/RB[/b] to navigate pages or note sides.[/*]
[*][b]B[/b] backs out of editing and returns to menu navigation, where it can close the reader.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Button names above use Xbox controls.[/i]


[size=5][b]Multiplayer and Saving[/b][/size]

Leave instructions in a shared chest, write letters to your friends, or build a collection of journals together.

[list]
[*]Writing, titles, signatures, and bookmarks stay with the physical item when it changes hands.[/*]
[*]Everyone playing should install Books and Notes and its required mods.[/*]
[*]Do not try to edit the same item simultaneously.[/*]
[*][b]Sleep and finish saving the day to save your writing with the farm.[/b] Closing a book keeps your draft, but does not perform a separate game save.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Settings and Compatibility[/b][/size]

By default, Books and Notes hides unrelated crafting and processing recipes from Si's Extra Crafting Materials to keep things focused on writing supplies.

[b]If another mod needs those other material recipes, turn off HideUnusedFrameworkItems in the Books and Notes content pack's settings.[/b] You can use Generic Mod Config Menu to change this in-game.
